title: Victoria Beckham Strikes a Pose in Outfit With Bold Neck for Her Own Brand - NewsBreak
text:
By Mehak Walia ,
2 hours ago Photo by Pierre Suu/GC Images/Getty Image Victoria Beckham has often gone above and beyond to prove that there is no muse as amazing as her. In fact, the designer recently proved this, yet again, as she stepped out in a striking look from her label, turning a simple pose into a full fashion moment.
For this, she struck an incomparable pose in a stylish black outfit with a visibly daring neckline and sharp tailoring. In fact, Beckham also added matching sunglasses from VB Eyewear to create a kind of style statement that only she can deliver, and that too, with this level of confidence, class, and charm.
Victoria Beckham sports black outfit with bold neckline for VB Eyewear Victoria Beckham always goes above and beyond to make her mark, and her latest look for VB Eyewear was no different. She opted for a simply stylish yet risqué outfit with a rather deep and alluring neckline, which made it look all the more fiery.
It’s quite safe to say that black and Victoria have an undeniably awesome bond. She also accessorized her modernized look with matching sunglasses and a chic hold bracelet, adding some additional sass to the whole look.
The post appeared first on .
